verdict.rationale: Baseten is driven by CLI and API rather than a UI. Deployments ship from a declarative `config.yaml` via `truss push` or `baseten model push`, and training checkpoints deploy with one CLI command. Inference runs over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, async inference reports results by webhook or polling, and stable dev/staging/production environments support scripted pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions or non-interactive API-key auth for pipelines), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
